notes.title: Quality Control...
notes.content:
Just posting a wee update.

I went back to Trawl and changed the sort of "title / on-boarding" screen. It now has a quality control between 1-5 which if you are familiar with Unity is just settings from "crappy looking" to "beautiful". It will also affect the amount of particles we render on your screen.

Hopefully this should help some lower end computers!

Regards
Danny

p.s. competition coming soon!

notes.title: Bug!
notes.content:
Hey sorry guys, I recently managed to put a pretty bad bug in the game and so it might have messed up sometimes and spawned a lot of items all at once!

I've since fixed this but there has been some interesting comments about the behaviours caused by it.

One guy at least seemed to get something out of saying it was "the single creepiest thing that's ever happened to me in a game ever". So not so bad then!

Again sorry and it should be totally fixed now!

- Dan

notes.content:

notes.title: EFIGS! and thankyous!
notes.content:
Hey Guys!

Firstly I wanna say a huge thank you to everyone who has played Trawl so far. We worked on this in our spare time for the last year or so and to  finally see people play it is really over whelming and amazing.

I have loved seeing community posts and screenshots go up and I implore you to please share your stories with us :)

We wanted to launch with EFIGS localisation in place but hit some tech problems that I have since managed to fix, so that is now live! The game can be played in English,French, Spanish, German and Italian.

In the future we would love to run some player competitions so stay tuned for some exciting new updates.

Danny
